answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks sybil attacks by making each identity pay to hold a slot. An agent locks 0.05 POA per slot; the deposit burns if it goes idle or cheats, and a slot frees only when a new deposit replaces it. A sybil operator needing 1,000 slots pays 1,000 x 0.05 = 50 POA, with cost growing linearly per fake identity. An honest agent pays only 0.05 POA for one slot and keeps working, like one ember glowing in an ocean of onyx dark.
